shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i 'dashboard|table|navigation|data grid|app shell' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/navigation && cat package.json && node -e \"for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/table','@gravity-ui/navigation']) console.log(p, require(p + '/package.json').version)\""

/bin/bash -lc "for p in uikit table navigation; do printf '%s ' \""'$p"; node -p "require('"'./node_modules/@gravity-ui/"'$p/package.json'"').version\"; find \"node_modules/@gravity-ui/"'$p" -path '"'*/docs/INDEX.md' -o -name README.md | head -8; done
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table ColumnReorderingProvider TableGroup
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -180
rg -n -C 4 'ColumnReorderingProvider|grouping|Grouped|columnOrder|column reordering|Group' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/dist node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json | head -220
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '250,330p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md && sed -n '440,480p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md && sed -n '25,65p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | rg -n -A12 'peerDependencies'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -35 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -10 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json | rg -n -A12 peerDependencies'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/app.css'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('.lavender { color: #7255d8; background: #f1edff; }.mint { color: #14866b; background: #e7f7f1; }.amber { color: #b87914; background: #fff5df; }.blue { color: #3d7dcc; background: #eaf3ff; }', '.lavender { color: var(--g-color-text-utility); background: var(--g-color-base-generic); }.mint { color: var(--g-color-text-positive); background: var(--g-color-base-generic); }.amber { color: var(--g-color-text-warning); background: var(--g-color-base-generic); }.blue { color: var(--g-color-text-info); background: var(--g-color-base-generic); }')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e 's/\\.lavender \\{ color: #7255d8; background: #f1edff; \\}\\.mint \\{ color: #14866b; background: #e7f7f1; \\}\\.amber \\{ color: #b87914; background: #fff5df; \\}\\.blue \\{ color: #3d7dcc; background: #eaf3ff; \\}/.lavender { color: var(--g-color-text-utility); background: var(--g-color-base-generic); }.mint { color: var(--g-color-text-positive); background: var(--g-color-base-generic); }.amber { color: var(--g-color-text-warning); background: var(--g-color-base-generic); }.blue { color: var(--g-color-text-info); background: var(--g-color-base-generic); }/' src/app.css
rg -n '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}|--g-color-text-info' src/app.css"
